payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all possible counts of substring b that can be formed from available letters, then fills the rest with as many c as possible, keeping the maximum total.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively searches the number of b occurrences to optimize total non-overlapping substrings. It stops when b cannot fit (feasibility bound). Among provided complete_search subtypes, branch and bound is the closest because it is an optimization search with a simple bound.
